title: Zesty Yeasty Venezuelan Corn Tagine
description: A yeasty, glassy-jelly one-pot Venezuelan dish featuring vanilla bean paste, cooked in a tagine style, and nut-free-friendly. This recipe combines the flavors of Venezuela with the traditional North African tagine cooking method.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the corn kernels, salt, sugar, and water to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the vanilla bean paste and active dry yeast.
Continue to simmer, covered, for an additional 10 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened and the yeast is fully dissolved.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs or a sprinkle of sugar if desired.
